parsed.reason: This is the plainest case executed perfectly. It asks one warm question ("How'd Swim class go?") without assuming the activity happened or went well. It explicitly takes off the pressure ("No pressure to write back"). The message is short, plain, first person, and contains nothing else - no padding, no exclamation marks, no emoji, no second questions, no invented specifics about the child or activity details. This is exactly what a friend would text when remembering to check in.
